notes.title: Bug fixes, head bob toggle, and more!
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Added preset options, choose from the original experience or the Fancy edition.
[*]Added a head bob toggle. Head bobbing is disabled by default in the Fancy preset.
[*]Added an option to auto equip the pistol when starting the first level. It is enabled by default in the Fancy preset.
[*]Adjusted mouse settings to be more sensitive.
[*]Fixed cutscenes not proceeding (after the red text). Previously you had to press the reload key, now you can press anything except escape, which skips the cutscene entirely.
[*]Fixed analog stick glyphs not showing up for Steam and PlayStation Controllers in the remapper.
[*]Minor visual adjustments to the launcher.
[/list]
Note: This update will reset your settings.
